plugins.name: nerd
plugins.description: Autonomous codebase research — discovers tunable parameters, runs experiments overnight in worktrees, delivers findings with KEEP/CHANGE/INVESTIGATE recommendations

plugins.name: clawcrush
plugins.description: Find and destroy zombie processes and repo slop spawned by Claude Code sessions

plugins.name: claude-modes
plugins.description: Modes as first-class Claude Code infrastructure — named, durable working stances that recompose the plugin catalog per mode via a cascading config system. Solves harness-bloat at scale.

plugins.name: auto
plugins.description: Workflow-agnostic pulsed loop engine with natural-language commands — runs the auto loop pattern (plan-loop, parallel fan-out, review-fix until only P3 issues remain) as a durable, observable state machine backed by a per-unit ledger. Three commands (/auto, /auto-status, /auto-resume) accept either explicit flags or freeform sentences. Workflow-blind: drives Compound Engineering, native Claude, or any workflow through a thin adapter.
